person.title: Senior Software Engineer
person.experience_summary: Eight years building backend services, the last four at Lattice Freight on its shipment tracking platform. Led the move from one large service to event-driven Go services on Kafka.

role.title: Senior Backend Engineer
role.description: Northwind Health runs the claims and eligibility checks that clinics call while a patient is at the front desk. The backend team owns those services end to end, from the API to the database and the on-call rotation.
highlights: Five or more years building backend services in Go or Java
Has split a large service into smaller ones

data.headline: Senior Backend Engineer
data.why_you: You led the move at Lattice Freight from one large service to event-driven Go services on Kafka. That is the work ahead here: claims still run through one large service, and the team wants someone who has split one before and kept it running in production.
data.team: Six backend engineers own the claims and eligibility services end to end. They ship small changes every day, run what they build and share on-call evenly.

process.note: With Jordan, about what you want next. No prep needed.
45 minutes with the head of backend on the claims work.
Two hours on a real design problem from the claims service, with two engineers.
We decide within a week of your last conversation.
